This is an interesting take from Qwen. They launched Qwen Intelligence, three AI agents built to get things done on a smartphone. 

A Planner breaks a request into steps, a Mobile-Use Agent carries them out across apps, using app interfaces where it can and tapping the screen where it must, with a reported 90% end-to-end success rate, and a Creative Agent turns one sentence into a finished image in about 3 seconds.

Currently, Apple Intelligence and Google's Gemini are integrated into smartphones and work "okay," but this would be the next big step toward truly integrating AI deeply into the operating system. And frankly, that's one of the biggest weaknesses so far. Running AI models completely at the edge requires small models that are also good enough. And we haven't quite reached that yet.
